02 / FILE GUIDE

A simple format. A reliable check.

Use these exact column names. Prices are in AUD; amounts accept up to two decimal places.

departmentDepartment or store name
itemExact name from your price list
quantityPositive whole number
sale_totalRecorded transaction amount
department,item,quantity,sale_total
Grocery,Orange,3,9.00
Produce,Carrot,2,5.00

Update the price lists before validating your own sales. Item and department names are case-sensitive. Refunds and discounts need separate rules and are not supported in v1.

HOW THE CHECK WORKS

Clear rules. Traceable results.

Expected total = the applicable unit price × quantity.

  • Prices and totals use exact integer cents. No tolerance is applied.
  • Department prices override base prices, including adding new items.
  • Quantity must be a positive whole number. Refunds are not supported.
  • Money must be non-negative with at most two decimal places; use no currency symbols or separators.
  • Missing fields, unknown items, and incorrect totals are flagged. The first applicable error is shown.
  • Only valid transactions contribute to revenue. The validation rate counts records, not units.
  • Row numbers are CSV record numbers including the header; quoted multiline fields count as one record.
  • Extra columns are accepted. Duplicate transactions are not automatically removed.
  • Downloads use formula-safe CSV text cells.
